title: Topic 16
japanese_text:
A：海、まだかなあ。もうかなり歩いてる気がするけど…。
B：待って、なんか<u>潮</u>の香りがしない？
A：ほんとだ！…あ！<u>浜</u>が見えてきたよ！ようやく<u>たどり着い</u>たね！わ〜、白い砂浜と青い海の<u>コントラスト</u>がいいね！
B：さすがは日本一と<u>名高い</u>ビーチ！水も<u>澄んで</u>てきれい！
english_translation: A: We haven't reached the sea yet. It feels like we've been walking for a while. B: Wait, can you smell the sea water? A: I can! Oh, and I can see the beach now! We've finally reached it! Wow, I love the contrast between the white sand and the blue ocean! B: That's why this is the most famous beach in Japan! The water is so clear and clean!
